title: The contract test checks what the dashboard client calls, not only the server's route table
name: client-parity
description: test/integration/contract.test.ts asserts 'the dashboard covers every operation' by comparing OPERATIONS with the server's COVERS — the route table's keys. The client (apps/dashboard/src) calls only 15 of them: write_brief, bind, archive, assign, claim, release, contributors_add, contributors_remove and init have a route and no UI, so the test is green over a real gap. Make the dashboard declare what it covers the way cli/src/covers.ts and mcp/src/covers.ts do, check that declaration against the calls the client actually makes through wire.ts, and compare it with OPERATIONS. Also add the state-changing operations the CLI and session have that OPERATIONS lacks — at least `correct_node`, `open_decision` if it belongs, `models add`, and starting/stopping the dispatcher — so the check sees them. Land it green with an explicit KNOWN_GAPS list that the test also fails on if an entry is already covered (a ratchet, like coverage-baseline.json); each dashboard node after this one deletes its own lines.
